current.text: He has a torn patellar tendon and is out. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
A return in March is likely. An earlier return would be a surprise.
He was playing well before the injury and ranked 105th after last season's trade deadline.
He is not draftable this season.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year. The team is worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans.
The Warriors' schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28, which is when he is expected back.

note: Moody is out with a torn patellar tendon and is not expected back before March. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 261, ESPN rank 345), so he should not be one of the 144 players drafted. Last season he was trending up (25.7 minutes, 2.5 threes, 12.1 points, 105th after the deadline). Watch his recovery news in February. If he returns in March and the Warriors play him, he could be a waiver pickup for threes in our playoff weeks.
